changes.text: 同治二年十月，官军已经攻破苏州外郭，守将李秀成、谭绍洸退进内城死守。官军从水陆三面合围，城里粮食吃完了，人心开始动摇。守军中的下级将领郜云官等人，向城外的官军将领程学启通款，请求投降。

In the tenth month of the second year of the Tongzhi reign, government forces had broken through the outer walls of Suzhou. The two commanders defending the city, Li Xiucheng and Tan Shaoguang, fell back into the inner city and held on. The besiegers closed in from three sides, by land and by water. Inside, the food ran out and the garrison's resolve began to waver. Gao Yunguan and other subordinate commanders among the defenders made overtures to Cheng Xueqi, a general on the government side outside the walls, offering to surrender.
投降不是递一句话就完的事。城里的郜云官要拿什么来换，换回什么，又凭什么相信对方会守约，都得当面谈清楚。这份降约怎么谈、靠什么让人相信，后来成了整件事的关键。

A surrender is not settled with a single message. Gao Yunguan needed to know what he would have to hand over, what he would receive in return, and why he should believe the other side would keep its word. All of it had to be agreed in person. How that pact was negotiated, and what made it believable, became the crux of everything that followed.
李鸿章的淮军刚到上海时，西方人看到他们衣帽粗陋，暗中嘲笑。李鸿章对身边的人说「軍之良窳，豈在服制耶」，意思是：军队好坏，难道在于穿什么吗？这句反问是对嘲笑的回应。他接着说，等对方见识了淮军大将的旗鼓，自然会有定论。后来欧美人看到淮军将校勇敢、纪律严整，都改了态度，常胜军也开始服从李鸿章的调度。

When Li Hongzhang's Huai Army first arrived in Shanghai, Westerners laughed behind their hands at the soldiers' rough clothes and caps. Li Hongzhang turned to the men around him and said, "Is the quality of an army to be judged by its uniforms?" The rhetorical question was his reply to the mockery. Let them see the banners and drums of our generals, he went on, and they will reach their own verdict. In time the Europeans and Americans saw how brave the Huai officers were and how strict their discipline, and their attitude changed. The Ever-Victorious Army, too, began to accept Li Hongzhang's command.
李秀成派部将纠合无锡、溧阳、宜兴等处八万多人、一千多条船，出运河口；自己率精锐数千人据守金匮，回援苏州。两路互相策应，与官军连战，互有胜负。十月十九日，李鸿章亲自督军，程学启和戈登担任先锋，苦战后攻破外郭。李秀成和谭绍洸退入内城，死守不屈。

Li Xiucheng sent his subordinate commanders to gather more than eighty thousand men from Wuxi, Liyang, Yixing and elsewhere, with over a thousand boats, out to the mouth of the Grand Canal, while he himself took several thousand picked troops to hold Jinkui and relieve Suzhou. The two forces supported each other and clashed repeatedly with the government side, each winning some and losing some. On the nineteenth day of the tenth month, with Li Hongzhang directing the attack in person and Cheng Xueqi and Gordon leading the vanguard, the government forces fought their way through the outer walls. Li Xiucheng and Tan Shaoguang withdrew into the inner city and refused to yield.
郜云官乞降之后，程学启和戈登亲自乘小船到城北的阳澄湖，与郜云官等人当面订约。双方约定的条件是：杀掉李秀成、谭绍洸，把首级献上来；作为交换，许给二品的官赏。戈登是这份约定的保人。梁启超紧接着写了一句「戈登爲之保人，故云官等不疑」：因为有戈登作保，郜云官等人才没有疑心。按梁启超的写法，降将肯信这份约，靠的是戈登的担保。

After Gao Yunguan's offer reached him, Cheng Xueqi went with Gordon by small boat to Yangcheng Lake, north of the city, to settle terms face to face with Gao and his fellow commanders. The terms agreed were these: kill Li Xiucheng and Tan Shaoguang and deliver their heads, and in return receive rewards of the second rank. Gordon acted as guarantor. Liang's next line, in translation, is that because Gordon stood as their guarantor, Gao Yunguan and the others had no doubts. As Liang tells it, what made the defectors trust the pact was Gordon's guarantee.
约定并没有被全盘接受。「然卒不忍害秀成，乃許斬紹洸而別」，意思是郜云官等人终究不忍心加害李秀成，只答应斩杀谭绍洸，然后散去。这是降约里的一次让步：城外要两个人的首级，降将只肯交出一个。

The terms were not accepted in full. Liang writes that in the end Gao Yunguan and the others could not bear to harm Li Xiucheng; they agreed only to behead Tan Shaoguang, and so they parted. This was a concession within the pact. The men outside the walls had asked for two heads, and the defectors would deliver only one.
城门开了，事情却没有结束。这八人的部下还有十几万人留在城中，梁启超形容为「聲勢洶洶」，意思是来势汹汹、气势逼人。程学启先前许过他们总兵、副将等官职，这时八人「求如約」，要求按约兑现。降约的前半段，是降将开门、献首级；现在轮到许诺的一方了。

The gates were open, but the matter was not closed. More than 100,000 of these eight men's troops were still inside the city, a force Liang describes as menacing, pressing and full of threat. Cheng Xueqi had earlier promised the eight posts such as brigade general and deputy general, and now they asked that the agreement be honoured. The defectors had done their part: they had opened the gates and handed over a head. It was now the turn of the side that had made the promises.
梁启超记下了程学启对这八个人的判断：「謂狼子野心，恐後不可制」，说他们像狼崽子一样野心难驯，将来恐怕控制不住。这是书中给出的理由。于是程学启与李鸿章秘密商议，在座舰上大摆宴席款待八人。「號炮一響，伏兵起而駢戮之」，号炮一响，埋伏的士兵冲出来，把八人一并杀死。他们的余党中，强行抵抗的一千多人也被杀，其余部众全部投降。苏州平定，李鸿章因功加太子少保。

Liang records Cheng Xueqi's judgment of the eight: in translation, he judged them wolf cubs at heart and feared they could not be controlled later, untameably ambitious men who might slip out of his grip. That is the reason the book gives. Cheng then plotted in secret with Li Hongzhang, and the eight were invited to a lavish banquet aboard a ship. When the signal gun sounded, the hidden soldiers rose and killed all eight together. More than a thousand of their followers who tried to resist were killed as well, and the rest of their troops surrendered. With Suzhou pacified, Li Hongzhang was rewarded with the honorary title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

现在回到阳澄湖那条小船上的第三个人。八人投降时，戈登是保人。梁启超写他「聞鴻章之食言也，大怒」：听说李鸿章不守诺言，戈登勃然大怒，想杀李鸿章抵罪，「自攜短銃以覓之」，亲自带着短枪去找李鸿章。「鴻章避之，不敢歸營」，李鸿章躲开了，不敢回营。几天后，戈登的怒气渐渐消了，这才作罢。梁启超在按语中评论说，李鸿章因此有愧于德：杀降违背公理，负约食言，欺骗戈登、辜负朋友；戈登如此痛恨，也在情理之中。他同时说，李鸿章或许是鉴于苗沛霖、李世忠的旧事，有不得已之处。

Now return to the third man in that small boat on Yangcheng Lake. When the eight surrendered, Gordon had been their guarantor. Liang writes, in effect, that when Gordon heard Li Hongzhang had broken his word, he was enraged. Gordon wanted to kill Li Hongzhang to make him pay, and went looking for him with a pistol himself. Li Hongzhang kept out of his way and dared not return to camp. After a few days Gordon's anger slowly cooled, and he let the matter drop. In a note of his own, Liang judges that Li Hongzhang fell short in virtue here: killing men who had surrendered violated public principle, going back on the agreement broke his word, and deceiving Gordon wronged a friend; Gordon's bitter fury, he says, was only fitting. He adds that Li Hongzhang may have had the earlier cases of Miao Peilin and Li Shizhong in mind, and may have acted under some real compulsion.

把这件事拆开看，降约里有三个角色。许诺的是程学启：湖上与降将订约的是他和戈登，许以总兵、副将等职的是他；作保的是戈登，书中明说降将「不疑」是因为他；决定不兑现的，是程学启与李鸿章的密谋。值得注意的是，主意出自程学启的判断，戈登去找的却是李鸿章，书里用的词也是“鸿章之食言”。梁启超自己也把这笔账记在李鸿章名下。一种解释是：在戈登看来，前线将领的许诺代表的是统帅；统帅点头杀降，就等于统帅本人食言。许诺可以由前线作出，兑现与否却要由上面来担。

Take the episode apart and the pact had three roles. Cheng Xueqi made the promise: he and Gordon settled terms with the defectors on the lake, and it was Cheng who promised them posts such as brigade general and deputy general. Gordon guaranteed it, and the book says plainly that the defectors had "no doubts" because of him. The decision not to pay came from the secret plan between Cheng and Li Hongzhang. Yet the idea grew out of Cheng's judgment, while the man Gordon went hunting for was Li Hongzhang, and the book's own phrase is that Hongzhang had broken his word. Liang himself, in his note, lays the account at Li Hongzhang's door. One reading is that, to Gordon, a field commander's promise spoke for his superior; once the superior agreed to kill men who had surrendered, the broken word was his. Promises may be made at the front, but whether they are kept is answered higher up.
第二层是保人的处境。书中写戈登是「聞」，本文据此推测，他是事后才听说这件事的。降将因为他才不起疑；降将被杀，他作保的那句话也跟着落空。梁启超也把这件事算作「欺戈登」，即欺骗了戈登。

The second layer is the guarantor's position. The book says Gordon heard of it; this article infers from that word that he learned of it after the fact. The defectors had trusted the pact because of him; when they were killed, his word as guarantor fell with them. Liang, too, counts the episode as a deception of Gordon.
第三层是程学启的理由。十几万部众、「聲勢洶洶」、「狼子野心」，书中给出的是一笔控制风险的账。梁启超在按语里还说，李鸿章或许是鉴于苗沛霖、李世忠的旧事，有不得已之处。另有一点可以留意：降约原本要两个人的首级，降将只交出一个，李秀成也走了。但本文不把这一点当作杀降的理由。

The third layer is Cheng Xueqi's reasoning. More than 100,000 troops, a "menacing" presence, men who were "wolf cubs at heart": what the book sets out is a calculation about controlling risk. In his note Liang also says that Li Hongzhang may have had the earlier cases of Miao Peilin and Li Shizhong in mind and acted under some real compulsion. One more detail invites attention. The pact had asked for two heads, the defectors delivered only one, and Li Xiucheng got away. But this article does not treat it as a reason for the killings.
代价也分两笔。眼前那笔很清楚：苏州到手，李鸿章加衔。长远那笔，书中只留下片段：李鸿章躲了几天，戈登怒气消退，常胜军之后仍与淮军并肩作战。后来的合作也不能证明这一步做对了，只能说明这道裂痕没有让双方当场决裂。如果承诺的风险真的太大，本文提出两种可能的做法：许诺之前先请统帅定好权限，反悔之前先和保人商量。这两种做法都是本文的假设。

The costs fall into two accounts. The immediate one is plain: Suzhou was taken and Li Hongzhang received a new title. Of the longer account, the book leaves only fragments. Li Hongzhang stayed out of sight for a few days, Gordon's anger subsided, and the Ever-Victorious Army went on fighting beside the Huai Army. Their later cooperation does not prove the decision was right; it shows only that the rift did not break them apart on the spot. If honouring the promise really carried too great a risk, this article suggests two other courses: before promising, agree with the commander-in-chief on the limits of what may be offered; before going back on the promise, consult the guarantor. Both are this article's own hypotheses.
本文只依据梁启超《李鸿章传》一部书。这部书以李鸿章为中心，降将一方和戈登本人的说法都没有进入证据。许诺的内容有两种说法：湖上订约时是“二品之赏”，城破后降将要求兑现的是“总兵副将等职”，本文无法判断两者的关系。十几万部众、一千多余党等数字，也都只出自这一处记载。

This article rests on a single book, Liang Qichao's biography of Li Hongzhang. The book centres on Li Hongzhang; neither the defectors' version nor Gordon's own account is among the evidence. The promise is also described in two ways: at the lake it was rewards of the second rank, while after the city fell the defectors asked for posts such as brigade general and deputy general. This article cannot determine how the two relate. The figures of more than 100,000 troops and more than a thousand followers killed likewise come from this one account alone.
